business_summary: Ningbo Lian Technology Co.,Ltd engages in the research and development, design, production, and sale of precision injection molds and injection molding products for companies in China and internationally. The company's injection molding products are mainly used in consumer electronics, toys, daily necessities, auto parts, and medical devices. It also produces precision injection molds; and purchases and sells non-injection toy products. The company was founded in 2006 and is based in Ningbo, China.
